## Testing notes

## Definition of Done

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit with the Jira key; branch is `feature/AOC-<n>-…` or `fix/AOC-<n>-…`
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion on the ticket is met, or the gap is explained above
- [ ] Tests added or updated: unit tests for logic, component or E2E tests for UI
- [ ] CI is green: lint (0 warnings), typecheck, tests with coverage, build, E2E
- [ ] Docs and ADRs updated where commands, behavior or conventions changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
